title: Annual evaluation of the fire chief
summary: Fire and Public Safety Commission members turned in fire chief evaluation forms to be combined for discussion in executive session. The commission then adopted the fire chief's fiscal year 2026 evaluation, to be sent to the mayor and County Council and published in the next meeting packet.

timeline.text: The evaluation will appear in next month's meeting packet.

Motion to adopt the fiscal year 2026 evaluation of the fire chief as drafted and transmit it to the mayor and county council: The commission adopted the fire chief's fiscal year 2026 evaluation as drafted, to be sent in writing to the mayor and County Council.
The evaluation forms will be combined for discussion in an executive session (a closed-door discussion).
